title: Switching Code of a Trace
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula of width at most $w$, and let a switching trace for $\varphi$ have index $k$. Its code is a switching code of width $w$ and index $k$. A final trace yields a final block code from the chosen literal positions and a satisfying assignment of the canonical compatible term; a recursive trace yields a nonzero block code from the current free literal positions and the chosen binary vector, followed by the code of the tail trace.
hypotheses_covered: A switching trace for $\varphi$ of index $k$
